channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Two Renoir paintings stolen from French museum, authorities report
item.description: Police are searching for suspects who broke into the Renoir Museum on the French Riviera and took two works by the impressionist artist, local officials...

item.title: Hurricane Lowell passes near Hawaii, bringing dangerous conditions
item.description: Hurricane Lowell is moving past western Hawaii, bringing strong winds, heavy rain, and large waves, according to the National Hurricane Center.

item.title: Hungary expels 10 Russian diplomats over 'unacceptable' conduct
item.description: Hungary has ordered ten Russian diplomats to leave the country due to activities deemed unacceptable.

item.title: Oil prices approach $100 a barrel amid U.S.-Iran standoff
item.description: Crude oil prices continue to climb as the ongoing U.S.-Iran dispute disrupts tanker traffic in the Strait of Hormuz.
